description: This file defines the 'Marshaler' class responsible for marshaling and unmarshaling JSON documents and PHP arrays into DynamoDB items, including handling of binary, number, set, list, and map types, with configurable options for error handling and number wrapping.

classes.name: Marshaler
classes.description: A class for converting between PHP data structures and DynamoDB item representations, supporting JSON and array marshaling, unmarshaling, and type-specific object creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Marshaler with optional configuration options, merging with default options.

methods.name: binary
methods.description: Creates a BinaryValue object to represent DynamoDB binary data.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Creates a NumberValue object to represent DynamoDB number data, preserving precision.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Creates a SetValue object to represent DynamoDB set data types.

methods.name: marshalJson
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a DynamoDB item array, validating JSON structure.

methods.name: marshalItem
methods.description: Converts a PHP array or object into a DynamoDB item array.

methods.name: marshalValue
methods.description: Recursively marshals a PHP value into DynamoDB attribute value format.

methods.name: unmarshalJson
methods.description: Converts a DynamoDB item array into a JSON string.

methods.name: unmarshalItem
methods.description: Converts a DynamoDB item array into a PHP array or object.

methods.name: unmarshalValue
methods.description: Recursively unmarshals a DynamoDB attribute value into a PHP value.

methods.name: handleInvalid
methods.description: Handles invalid values during marshaling based on configuration, either ignoring, nullifying, or throwing exceptions.
